baseline_models.mechanism: Opinion-bound groups take mutually different routes, so divergence generated inside a shared relation converts that relation into a fault line.

activation_trace.role: The image of companions taking unlike routes supplies the active divergence that fractures a common course.
An opinion-bound group makes the plural parties coalitions organized around rival positions.
The bond joining sides makes baynihim a shared relation that disagreement ruptures, not merely empty space.

changed_reading.before: Several groups happened to disagree among themselves.
changed_reading.after: The parties are produced as rival opinion-coalitions when members of one relational field take incompatible routes from within it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: Blocking truth is answered by an attended, knowledge-declaring scene; the day is an overwhelming occurrence rather than a neutral date.

activation_trace.role: Blocking the truth gives disbelief the operative act that the coming scene will answer.
Presence with direct viewing makes the threatened scene an unavoidable encounter with what was denied.
Knowledge-based declaration gives the scene an evidentiary and adjudicative function, beyond spectacle.
The day as a severe occurrence turns calendar time into the event of reckoning itself.
The image of a grievous descending calamity supplies the event's crushing magnitude.

changed_reading.before: Woe is threatened for disbelief on a great future day.
changed_reading.after: Woe comes from an evidentiary event in which truth-blocking fails because the deniers must be present before what declares itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: A singular saying fixed as true becomes the object of sharp verbal contest; sayings become positions, positions gather adherents, and the resulting coalitions enact ikhtilaf.

activation_trace.role: Saying as belief or doctrine lets qawl become a position around which a party can form.
Truth as stable correspondence supplies the singular fixed referent that rival positions contest.
Sharp verbal wrangling supplies the process by which the truth-saying is pulled into factional argument.
The opinion-coalition branch supplies the social form produced by the preceding dispute.
Taking unlike routes supplies the final divergence of the newly legible positions.

structural_cues: 19:34 places one qawl al-haqq immediately before the plural parties of 19:37.
The sequence moves from ongoing yamtarun to resultant ikhtalafa, with 19:35-36 restating divine act and one path between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a singular truth-saying, sharp dispute, opinion-coalitions, and unlike routes; I infer that repeated claims harden into parties. A live alternative is that ahzab names groups already formed before this argument.

changed_reading.after: The parties are discourse coalitions crystallized by rival doctrinal sayings around the one saying marked as truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding singular straight path supplies a common line; the focus branch of each taking a different route turns disagreement into a spatial fan-out from that line.

activation_trace.role: The straight-road image supplies the single common course against which divergence is measured.
Uprightness and balanced straightness reinforce that the announced path is aligned rather than one option among peers.
Each person's unlike route converts doctrinal difference into departure from the just-announced line.
Opinion-bound groups make the divergent routes collective tracks rather than isolated mistakes.

structural_cues: 19:36 ends with the deictic singular 'this is a straight path'; 19:37 begins with fa- and plural parties.
The route image belongs to the focus kh-l-f inventory itself, so the context sharpens an existing anchor rather than importing a free metaphor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one straight road followed by groups taking unlike roads; I infer that 19:37 narrates a fan-out from 19:36's course. Alternatively, the road may state a norm while the disagreement remains non-spatial argument.

changed_reading.before: The parties hold different opinions after a statement of guidance.
changed_reading.after: The singular straight course visibly branches into collective rival tracks as soon as the parties take unlike routes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope moves from a screening barrier and truth-covering to witnessed presence, acute hearing and sight, manifest condition, and finally the stripping of cover named inside regret; heedlessness is exposed as the present posture before that reversal.

activation_trace.role: A screening barrier establishes the pericope's initial material image of protected visual enclosure.
Covering supplies the deniers' present action and links doctrinal refusal to the earlier screen.
Attended direct viewing makes mashhad the point where maintained distance collapses.
Auditory perception supplies one immediately post-focus mode of unavoidable reception.
Eye-sight supplies the paired visual mode that realizes the witnessing scene.
Appearance and disclosure pivot the focus root from relation between parties to the manifestness of their condition.
Stripping a cover gives the day of regret a latent material reversal of k-f-r's covering.
Deliberate heedlessness identifies the live alternative posture: maintained inattention before forced disclosure.

structural_cues: The barrier occurs near the opening; paired hearing and sight follow the focus immediately.
19:39 repeats yawm and contrasts present heedlessness and nonbelief with the completed affair.
The same b-y-n root moves from baynihim in 19:37 to mubin in 19:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies barrier, covering, witnessed presence, hearing, sight, disclosure, stripped cover, and heedlessness; I infer a temporal reversal from chosen occlusion to compulsory perception. Alternatively, the hearing and sight may intensify judgment without recalling the earlier barrier.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers are punished when they attend a frightening scene.
changed_reading.after: Their woe is an epistemic reversal: those who cover truth and remain heedless must become acute hearers and seers in the scene where cover is stripped and their condition is manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated movement aside and a screening barrier keep the sign private; Mary's return carrying it into her people reverses that motion, and the focus converts spatial separation into an internal social split.

activation_trace.role: Moving aside into a separate quarter starts the spatial withdrawal that precedes public controversy.
A screening barrier materializes the boundary between private event and surrounding people.
The repeated move aside prolongs the sign's removed, nonpublic phase.
The people as a social collective supply the public body into which the carried sign returns.
The relation joining the sides supplies the communal fabric transformed into a fissure.
Unlike routes convert the earlier physical apartness into opposed public trajectories.
Opinion-coalitions are the social residue when the returned sign is contested.

structural_cues: Intabadhat recurs at 19:16 and 19:22 before 19:27 reverses direction: she comes to her people carrying the child.
Accusation and responsive sign or speech intervene between the return and the final split from within baynihim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, barrier, repeated remoteness, return to a collective, and internal divergence; I infer that private spatial separation is converted into public social factionalization. Alternatively, Mary's withdrawal may stage privacy without causing the later parties.

changed_reading.before: The narrative ends by noting a later abstract religious disagreement.
changed_reading.after: A sign kept behind spatial boundaries reenters its people and becomes the pressure that splits a shared social relation into public opinion-coalitions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries an obstetric sh-h-d branch into an eschatological noun; it remains packet-anchored because mashhad is the focus word and labor, what will emerge, and birth recur nearby. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary material echo, never as the ordinary lexical sense of mashhad.

activation_trace.role: A thing laboring with what will emerge supplies the nearby process of hidden content becoming manifest.
The occurrence of birth and delivery makes emergence an explicit threshold in the surrounding sequence.
What comes out at birth is the form-distant focus branch that lets mashhad faintly echo an emergence into public presence.
Covering supplies the hidden state from which the exploratory emergence reading moves.

changed_reading.before: Mashhad is solely the public scene at which people are present.
changed_reading.after: At a secondary material register, the scene is also an emergence: what was carried, screened, and covered is brought out into undeniable public presence.

strongest_changes: The parties become discourse coalitions produced by sharp contest over the singular saying of truth, not merely a fixed list of sects.
The immediate move from one straight path to the focus branch of unlike routes spatializes disagreement as a fan-out from one course.
Covering and heedlessness are reversed by witnessed presence, acute hearing and sight, manifest condition, and stripped cover.
Repeated withdrawal, barrier, and return let the final disagreement read as a private sign becoming a public social fissure.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's sequences do more than group themes: b-y-n moves from mutual relation to mubin disclosure, kh-l-f's divergent routes answer sirat mustaqim, and sh-h-d's birth branch preserves a contained emergence echo.
remaining_uncertainties: Min baynihim may stress rupture of an existing bond, or simply locate disagreement among the members.
The barrier-to-disclosure arc may be deliberate architecture, or a reader-supplied long-range echo.
The obstetric sh-h-d activation is branch-valid but form-distant and must remain secondary.
